# Vibe Coding Tools

> Static open-source directory comparing 36 AI coding platforms across AI IDEs, CLI agents, and no-code app builders by pricing, open source license, pros, cons, build goal, and source code export.

- Live directory: https://developer-assistants.github.io/vibe-coding-tools/
- Repository: https://github.com/developer-assistants/vibe-coding-tools
- Raw dataset: https://developer-assistants.github.io/vibe-coding-tools/data/tools.json
- License: MIT

## Featured platforms
- Codex (CLI Agents): Open-source CLI by OpenAI for full-stack development.
- Claude Code (CLI Agents): Terminal coding agent by Anthropic for complex codebases.
- Cursor (AI IDE): AI-native VS Code fork for professional developers.
- Lovable (No-code): Full-stack AI web app builder with two-way GitHub sync.
- Bolt.new (No-code): Browser-based WebContainer app builder for rapid prototyping.
- Replit Agent (No-code): Cloud IDE and hosting platform to build and deploy in one place.
- Windsurf (AI IDE): Agentic AI IDE with Cascade flows.
- Aider (CLI Agents): Free Apache-2.0 terminal pair programmer with native Git commits.
